BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Silver Holdco JV, LLC was the 50/50 Macquarie Infrastructure Partners V and Medical Properties Trust lessor partnership for eight Steward-operated Massachusetts hospitals.

The approximately US$1.7bn portfolio closed on March 14, 2022 under long-term triple-net leases. Steward's 2024 bankruptcy ended the lease economics, and Macquarie and Medical Properties Trust surrendered the collateral and cash to Apollo-managed lenders in exchange for debt releases. Five hospitals were subsequently sold, St. Elizabeth's transferred to Massachusetts, and Carney and Nashoba remained in a separate lender workout vehicle. The original Silver Holdco platform is therefore realized from 2024; successor operators, government transferees, individual property SPVs and the lender workout pool are not counted as successor PortCos.

STORY TIMELINE
Sep 2024
Exit

Bankruptcy-court orders terminated the Steward lease and transferred the original partnership collateral to Apollo-managed lenders, realizing the Macquarie and Medical Properties Trust ownership periods.

Mar 16, 2022
Investment

Medical Properties Trust announced completion of the 50/50 Silver Holdco hospital partnership with Macquarie Infrastructure Partners V.

Mar 14, 2022
Founding

Silver Holdco JV, LLC closed the acquisition of the eight-property hospital lessor portfolio.

Sep 1, 2021
Financing

Macquarie Infrastructure Partners V and Medical Properties Trust announced a 50/50 partnership for eight Massachusetts hospital properties valued at approximately US$1.78bn.
